h1: The 7 Best Bissell Upright Vacuums of 2026, Ranked & Reviewed
metaDescription: Ranked and reviewed by Primea: seven Bissell upright vacuums from the dual-brush Pet Hair Eraser to compact CleanView models, by pets, allergies and storage.
summary: The Bissell Pet Hair Eraser DualBrush 42946 is our best overall, with self-cleaning brushes and a HEPA sealed system. The CleanView Swivel Pet 2252 is the pick for shedding pets, and the Pet Hair Eraser Allergen Lift-Off 39883 suits allergy-sensitive homes. The CleanView 3508 is the compact choice for tight storage.
intro: Bissell's upright range looks like a wall of near-identical model numbers, and the real differences hide in three places: the brush system, the filter and how the machine stores. If you only compare price you will likely buy a vacuum that is wrong for your pets or your closet.

We reviewed seven Bissell uprights on paper, ranking them on brush design, filtration, tank capacity, maneuverability and storage size. The listings for some models state little, so we kept claims to what each one actually says.

products.name: Bissell Pet Hair Eraser DualBrush Upright Vacuum with Two Brush Rolls, DualBrush Self-Cleaning Technology, HEPA Sealed Allergen System, Bright FurFinder Headlights, Lift-Off Pod, 42946
products.verdict: Bissell's newest dual-brush hardware with HEPA and headlights.
products.description:
The Bissell 42946 pairs two brush rolls with DualBrush self-cleaning technology, a HEPA sealed allergen system and bright FurFinder headlights. It also has a lift-off pod for portable cleaning.

It ranks first because it stacks the most features of any model here: self-cleaning brushes, sealed HEPA filtration and headlights that reveal hair. Next to the CleanView 2252 below it, you pay in the $200-500 bracket for the newer hardware.

Buy it if you want Bissell's latest dual-brush system. The caveat is that it costs the most of the group.
products.idealFor: Buyers who want Bissell's newest hardware.

products.name: Bissell CleanView Swivel Pet Upright Vacuum, Swivel Steering for Maneuverability, Triple Action Brush Roll for Pet Hair, Large Capacity Dirt Tank & Scatter-Free Tech, 2252
products.verdict: Swivel steering and a triple action brush for pet hair.
products.description:
The CleanView Swivel Pet 2252 offers swivel steering, a triple action brush roll for pet hair, a large capacity dirt tank and scatter-free technology.

It ranks second because it handles pet hair with a purpose-built brush at less than the 42946. Expect it in the $100 to $200 bracket. It lacks the dual self-cleaning brushes and HEPA sealed system listed on the top pick.

Choose it for homes with shedding pets. The caveat is that the listing mentions no HEPA system.

products.name: Bissell Pet Hair Eraser Allergen Lift-Off, HEPA, 39883
products.verdict: A Pet Hair Eraser with HEPA and a lift-off design.
products.description:
The Pet Hair Eraser Allergen Lift-Off 39883 is named for its HEPA filtration and lift-off design. Our data lists few other specs.

It ranks third because the listing is thin compared with the 42946 and 2252, though HEPA and the lift-off format fit allergy-sensitive homes. It is priced somewhere from $100 to $200.

Choose it if allergies matter. The caveat is that you should confirm the full spec list before buying.
products.skipIf: You want a full feature list.

products.name: Bissell CleanView Upright Vacuum with Active Extension Wand, XL 2L Dirt Tank Capacity, Powerful Suction & OnePass Technology for Carpets & Hard Floors, 3536
products.verdict: A 2L tank and OnePass for carpets and hard floors.
products.description:
The CleanView 3536 has an XL 2L dirt tank, an active extension wand and OnePass technology for carpets and hard floors.

It ranks fourth because it has no pet or HEPA features listed, unlike the models above. It does cost less. Expect it in the $50 to $100 bracket.

Choose it for smaller homes and apartments. The caveat is the lack of pet-specific hardware.
pros: Works on carpet and hard floor

products.name: Bissell CleanView Swivel Vacuum, Triple Action Brush Roll, 3836
products.verdict: Swivel handling with a triple action brush roll.
products.description:
The CleanView Swivel 3836 is listed with a triple action brush roll and swivel in the name. The listing gives little more.

It ranks fifth because it is a general-purpose version of the pet 2252, without the pet-hair brush wording. It is priced somewhere from $100 to $200.

Choose it for comparison shopping inside the Swivel line. The caveat is that more detailed specs are not listed.

products.name: Bissell CleanView Upright Vacuum, 4438
products.verdict: A CleanView upright aimed at solid performance for less.
products.description:
The CleanView 4438 is a basic CleanView upright, with no feature list in our data.

It ranks sixth because we have fewer facts than for the models above. It sits in the $50-100 bracket, which is where its appeal lies.

Choose it if you want a Bissell upright for less. The caveat is that you should read the listing for specifics.
products.idealFor: Buyers who want a Bissell upright for less.

products.name: Bissell CleanView Compact, Powerful Suction & Extension Wand, 3508
products.verdict: A compact CleanView with an extension wand.
products.description:
The CleanView Compact 3508 is a compact upright with an extension wand and powerful suction wording.

It ranks last because it is the most basic in features. Its compact size is its selling point. Expect it in the $50 to $100 bracket.

Choose it for the tightest storage spaces. The caveat is limited detail on tank size.

whatMatters.detail: A brush roll agitates carpet to lift dirt. Dual and triple action designs target pet hair and tangles. Look for the brush wording in the title.
HEPA captures fine particles that standard filters pass back into the air. It matters for allergies. Look for 'HEPA' or 'sealed' on the listing.
A bigger tank means fewer trips to the bin. The 3536 lists 2L. Check for a stated liter figure.
Swivel steering makes turns easier around furniture. It matters in cluttered rooms. Look for the word 'swivel'.
Uprights are tall and hard to store. A compact model like the 3508 fits tighter spaces. Measure your closet.

faq.q: Which Bissell is best for pet hair?
faq.a: The CleanView Swivel Pet 2252 has a triple action brush for pet hair. The 42946 adds dual self-cleaning brushes.

faq.q: What mistake do buyers make with Bissell?
faq.a: They pick by price alone and miss the brush and filter differences. Compare those first.

faq.q: Is the 42946 worth it over the 2252?
faq.a: If you want HEPA and dual self-cleaning brushes, yes. The 2252 costs less and handles pet hair well on paper.

faq.q: How do I clean the brush roll?
faq.a: Remove the roll and clear hair by hand. The 42946 lists self-cleaning technology.

faq.q: How do I maintain the filter?
faq.a: Rinse or replace it per the manual. Check the manual for your model.

faq.q: Can a compact upright handle a whole home?
faq.a: The 3508 is compact and best for smaller homes. Check tank size for larger ones.

finalTake: The Bissell Pet Hair Eraser DualBrush 42946 is the best overall for pet homes that want HEPA and self-cleaning brushes. The CleanView Swivel Pet 2252 is the better value for shedding pets, and the 3508 suits small closets. Compare brushes and filters before price.
